import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import PatternFill
from copy import copy

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('OUT_XLSX')
ws = wb['Pay Items']

# Add formulas for A20:A26 and B20:B26
for row in range(20, 27):
    # A column: Pay Item Number lookup
    ws.cell(row=row, column=1).value = f'=IF(C{row}="","",IFERROR(INDEX($A$3:$A$17,MATCH(C{row},$C$3:$C$17,0)),""))'
    # B column: UOM lookup
    ws.cell(row=row, column=2).value = f'=IF(C{row}="","",IFERROR(INDEX($B$3:$B$17,MATCH(C{row},$C$3:$C$17,0)),""))'

# Color rows 20-26, columns A & B with #FFF2CC
fill = PatternFill(start_color='FFF2CC', end_color='FFF2CC', fill_type='solid')
for row in range(20, 27):
    ws.cell(row=row, column=1).fill = fill
    ws.cell(row=row, column=2).fill = fill

wb.save('OUT_XLSX')
print('Done')
